title: 받아쓰기 4: 연음 — 받침이 넘어가요
objective: Say 음악 [으막] correctly and write the right spelling when you hear the linked sound.
summary: Learn how a 받침 moves into a next syllable that starts with ㅇ.

task.title: Say it and spell it
task.line: Read each item aloud first, then write the sound in [ ] or the correct spelling.

letters.sound: A final consonant moves into the next empty ㅇ slot.
ㅇ (ng) never moves. It stays at the end.
If you hear [오시], write 옷이. Keep the 받침 in the spelling.
letters.as: Like English 'Wednesday': you don't write it the way you say it.

exercises: Write how it sounds, in [ ]: ① 목요일 ② 발음 ③ 손이
You hear this sound. Write the correct spelling: ① [그묘일] ② [사라미] ③ [오느른]
Does the 받침 move to the next syllable? Write Yes or No: ① 강아지 ② 산이 ③ 물을
You hear these sentences. Write them in correct Korean spelling: ① [우사늘 사요] ② [일보네 가요]
answers: ① 금요일 ② 사람이 ③ 오늘은
① No [강아지] ② Yes [사니] ③ Yes [무를]
① 우산을 사요 ② 일본에 가요
